info.name: Knowledge Graph API v5 (Header Auth + Property Security)
info.description: Multi-Tenant Knowledge Graph API with dynamically generated endpoints. All standard entities (Person, Organization, Location, Skill, Education, Course, Department) are served by a single generic service with configuration-driven routes.

request.description: List all active merged duplicate groups with their canonical nodes
Delete any entity by its entity_id (resolves canonical automatically)
Simple search across default text fields
Use operators like prefix (*), fuzzy (~), phrase, AND/OR
Field filters + ranges + relationship filters + facets + aggregations + explain
Relationship-aware matching without hardcoded entity logic
Initialize and verify search engine capabilities
Returns every SchemaProperty with its security level (1-6). 1=open, 6=highest. Properties above the caller x-authz-env-{tenant} level are hidden on GET and blocked on write.
Callers with env-level < 5 get "[HIDDEN]" for salary_band on read and 403 on write.
Callers with env-level < 3 get "[HIDDEN]" for gpa on read and 403 on write.
Level 1 = no restriction (default for all properties).
